items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: But I just went because we knew them so good.

ctx.x: Did he play the snares or the bass drum or both of these?

He played, he played, he played a bass drum and then he had them little, what you call them, tambourines that hit on, they played that too. Then he had them sags you hit on the drum, you know, like little brooms, you know. He played that. He was a great musician, you know. And we went to a cornerstone laying in Covent that Benny played. The whole band played that. And Bueller's mother had, Church had given it as a National Academy. But I just went because we knew them so good. But anyway, and Benny played that…
Well, the Catholic people used to have bands with them too? I see that's how I remember.
